summary: On July 21, 2026, Wise Group plc (Nasdaq: WSE; LSE: WISE) announced a share buyback program via a Form 6-K furnished with an RNS announcement. The company entered into non-discretionary arrangements with Goldman Sachs International to repurchase up to £405M (~$540M) of its Class A ordinary shares. Purchases may occur on Nasdaq, LSE, Cboe Europe, and Aquis. Approximately 40% of repurchased shares will transfer to an Employee Share Trust for equity awards; 60% will be held in treasury. The buyback runs through March 31, 2027, under Rule 10b-18 and the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The program reduces share capital and satisfies employee obligations. Watch for updates on shareholder authority renewal at the 2026 AGM.
